Title: Still not losing fat even though you're eating less? 4 foods to try on an empty stomach

Description:
It might not be about how little you eat — it's about what you put in your stomach first. Starting the day with refined carbs sends blood sugar way up, which triggers an insulin surge that tells your body to store fat instead of burning it.

Eggs, chia seed water, apple cider vinegar, and green tea — four things worth trying on an empty stomach, backed by real research. Watch to find out why each one helps.
